title: PREREG_IMPROVE (iteration 5, Part A, H-IMPROVE): label-free rescorings of cross-family consensus, screened on dataset E
status_of_E: DEVELOPMENT data (labels seen in iterations 2-4). Every E number is a development number; E2 / R_COMP FREE confirms.
diagnosis_targeted: wrong, scattered peers dilute a correct candidate's plurality (eval-2/eval-3: 61-77% of peers disagreeing with CORRECT candidates are ERROR; only 9% of CORRECT-CORRECT disagreement is vocabulary)
input_matrix: iter_3 gen_art_evaluation_2/pairwise_classes_E.jsonl (label-free; 29,107 node pairs; eqmv 3000 ms; z3 5.1.0; code_sha dd73975642f428cc) = the ONLY input to scoring
peer_pool: P(x) = parseable rows with is_peer True, vendor `family` != family(x), excluding x (exp-5 leave-own-family-out); |P| < 2 -> None (imputed neutral 0.6266 downstream, exp-5 prereg); unparseable -> 1.0

variants.V0: frozen c_score_align (exp 5 column in per_item_T1); V0_rep = 1 - |{p in P: A(x,p)}|/|P| from the matrix (reproduction gate G1 only)
variants.V1 c_pn: 1 - min(1, share_A(x)/max_class_share); share_A = |{p in P: A}|/|P|; classes = eval-2 greedy cliques restricted to P's rows; max_class_share = max_c |c ∩ P|/|P|; share_A == 0 -> 1.0
variants.V2 c_rw: weights: for fold k, over sentences s NOT in fold k, for each family f with >=1 peer row and >=1 other-family peer row: agr_f(s) = mean over (r in f, q not in f) of A(r,q); a_f = mean_s agr_f(s); n_f = #such sentences; abar = mean over all (f,s) agr_f(s); w_f^(k) = (n_f a_f + 20 abar)/(n_f + 20). c_rw(x) = 1 - sum_{p in P, A} w_f(p) / sum_{p in P} w_f(p) with fold(x)'s weights. Full-E weights saved for reference.
variants.V3 c_pn_rw: V1 with w-weighted shares (candidate share and class shares)
variants.V4 c_two_channel: logistic(c_exact, c_align=V0 frozen) sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1e6, intercept) cross-fitted on Z rows: for fold k fit on Z rows of the other folds, predict fold k; rows outside Z get the full-Z fit; then refit ONCE on all Z = frozen coefficients. c_exact = 1 - share of P with kind=='exact' (or same node).
variants.V5 c_v5: V3 with P restricted to families {deepseek, microsoft, openai} minus own family (eval-2 cross-fitted best 3-pool); 'openai' includes the frontier slot F (family 'openai' in the matrix); empty 3-pool -> None -> neutral 0.6266 (eval-2 c_k3 convention)

fold_recipe: fold = int(sha1('E_folds_v1|' + sentence_id), 16) % 5; asserted equal to per_item_T1 fold_E

population.R_AB: per_item_T1 in_R_AB & pool == 'E_POOL' & parse_ok (n 2,686; 1,822 ERROR / 864 CORRECT; 292 sentences)
population.Z: R_AB rows present in the matrix with |P| >= 2 (expected 2,672); every paired variant comparison uses Z; V0 frozen is also reported on the full 2,686

cells.LONG-strat: Z ∩ {L25,L20,EXC}, within-stratum AUROC (exp-6 prereg_T1 criteria.a long pool = L25+L20+EXC, asserted)

words_terciles: eval-2 prereg_mech.json cuts [20, 26] on sentence words: T1 <= 20 < T2 <= 26 < T3

bootstrap.implementation: eval-2 SentBoot multiplicity weights (identical draws to exp-6 ClusterBoot for the same seed)

binary_decomposition: flag = c > 0.5 (V4: threshold matched to V0's flag rate on Z); e = share of ERROR rows NOT flagged; d = share of CORRECT rows flagged; AUROC_b = 1 - (e+d)/2
T9_error_classes: exp-9 analyse.py classes(r) verbatim: ADD, DROP, COMPOUND, polarity(NEG/REV/QUANT), structural(CONN/RESTR/BIND/MOVE/SWAP/SCOPE/UNGLUE), MEANING_RENAME-type (MEANING_RENAME op or auto_label VOCAB_GRAN)
selection_rule: winner = the variant (V1..V5) with the highest E LONG-strat AUROC on Z that (i) beats V0 (frozen) by >= +0.015 there AND (ii) is >= V0 on L25 (point) AND (iii) is >= V0 - 0.01 on CTRL; if none qualifies -> 'NONE: V0 stands'; tie (|Δ| < 1e-4) -> the cheaper (cost order V5 < V0 = V1 = V2 = V3 = V4)
screen_margin_note: +0.015 is a heuristic selection threshold far below the E long-pool SE (~0.02-0.025); it is NOT a significance claim. The winner is only a CANDIDATE for E2.

reported_not_gating.selection_stability: B=500 sentence-cluster resamples drawn WITHIN strata (seed 20260924+1); re-run the rule on each; report the share selecting each variant / NONE
reported_not_gating.permutation_null: B=200 within-stratum label permutations (seed 20260924+2); report the share of permutations in which ANY variant qualifies under the rule
reported_not_gating.oracle_gap: eval-3 R_oracle (9-family and 3-pool); gap_closed = (d_V0 - d_v)/(d_V0 - d_oracle) only if the denominator >= 0.05, else ILL_CONDITIONED; e_v printed beside it
reported_not_gating.context_comparators: Δ vs judge_cheap_disg, judge_cheap_orig, judge_cheap2_orig (frozen exp-6 columns)

gates.G0: exp-6 estimator reproduces V0 strat 0.741 / Δ +0.099 [0.049,0.146] / long +0.116 to 1e-3 (PASSED before this prereg, results/gate_G0.json)
gates.G1: V0_rep vs frozen c_score_align mismatch share <= 0.5% (|diff| > 1e-9) over rows where both are defined; c_exact pooled AUROC reproduces eval-2's 0.748 on Z; 3-pool plain c reproduces eval-2 c_k3 (0.785 pooled)

seal: scores_E_variants.jsonl is written by src/score_variants.py, which reads ONLY the matrix and a label-stripped row index (allowed-inputs list logged with sha256); its sha256 goes to prereg_improve_addendum.json BEFORE src/fit_v4.py or src/screen.py read any label.
immutability: after marker M1 (freeze/CONSENSUS_FREEZE_READY.json) consensus_variants.py and selection.json are immutable; later fixes go to new files + deviations.json
